pr_title: Bluetooth: audio: check MCS characteristic properties before subscribe
pr_body:
MCC need to check characteristic properties before subscribe as not all
MCS characteristics support notify.

Signed-off-by: Hang Fan <fanhang@xiaomi.com>

Fix: #49142

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Audio: MCC subscribe failure
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**

From this change #45762, MCC serialize subscribe after discovery. If one of MCS characteristic subscribe fail, the rest of characteristics would not to subscribe.

But from MCS Spec, some MCS characteristics just **Optional** to support notify, not **Mandatory**. For now MCC subscribe all these characteristics It may fail and affect other subscription.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13658277/185042732-d106cb98-bd90-4a8d-a33b-5d18c2177c6b.png)

**Describe the solution you'd like**
check MCS characteristic properties before subscribe

review_comments: Since `do_subscribe` actually does `sub_params->value = BT_GATT_CCC_NOTIFY;` why may want to remove that, so that we don't overwrite this value. It'll work the same either way, but there's no need to overwrite the value in `do_subscribe` anymore.
